policy.purpose: Stress existing-data calibration before changing the working coefficients
policy.selectionPolicy: Parameter fitting uses fit rows only. Evaluate every fitted winner on the same archived v2.8 check rows, and separately its own check rows. These are already-exposed engineering checks, not blind validation.
policy.promotionPolicy: A single fixed candidate must beat v2.8 P47 original-check climb MAE by at least 10 ft/min and stay within +0.5 mph speed / +10 ft/min climb MAE for every aircraft on original check rows AND on each of the three own-split check sets. Candidates are split winners and original-split near-optimal families. No promotion solely for lower training score or a lower Spitfire e.
policy.scenarioPolicy: Graph-reading bounds are reading brackets, not historical confidence intervals. Weight and +/-100 RPM perturbations are assumed scenarios, not measured uncertainty. No interpolation or extrapolation of chart power. No fit of new aircraft or new historical observations.

decision.reason: No cross-split gain passes every documented guardrail; retain working coefficients.
